name: codex-local-privacy-router
description: Assess every user prompt in a locally deployed main session, preserve workflow state across follow-ups, and require redaction confirmation before sensitive cloud analysis.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate a locally deployed main-session model with cloud analysis. Simple tasks stay local. Complex non-sensitive tasks use an eligible cloud model; sensitive material is redacted locally and reviewed by the user before handoff. The main session returns the final answer. Requires a compatible host and a separately configured local main-session model.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this material, assess its privacy locally, and confirm redaction before any sensitive cloud handoff.
Decide whether the local main-session model should handle this task or hand it to a cloud large-model subagent.
Identify sensitive information in this file locally and generate a redaction preview for confirmation.
